name: Old Village of Hollókő and its Surroundings
description: Hollókő is a small village in the hills of Nógrád County, northern Hungary, home to the Palóc people. Its whitewashed, timber-framed houses with carved wooden eaves still line the same lanes, with farmyards and orchards around them. The village dates to the 13th century, and its name means "Raven-stone." Today it gives a rare glimpse of rural life before modern farming changed the countryside.
